items.title: Hosting and Content Security Policy integration
acceptance_checks: Preserve the failed public-browser observations and distinguish the functional checks from the strict no-console gate; identify the exact injected host script and affected deployment.
Resolve hosting integration through supported controls without weakening Content Security Policy, allowing arbitrary inline scripts, bypassing hosting controls or hiding console failures.
Rerun the same exact-version historical-profile journeys in Chrome, Firefox and WebKit; require both functional and strict console gates to pass and preserve source/context hashes.
Record any full-corpus public-browser or AI-client check separately; a hosting fix does not establish model-answer quality or legal applicability.
items.scope_note: At the recorded public deployment, functional assertions passed in all nine browser cases but the strict console gate failed in all nine. The service blocked an injected Cloudflare inline challenge loader; Firefox also reported invalid-domain __cf_bm cookies. SDK package integrity remains separately verified; no remediation or browser acceptance is yet claimed.
